decisions_for_a_person: Choose Option A (5 units of O-2205 for Tall Pines Coffee House ready 4 days late, late penalty applies) or Option B (40 units of O-2203 for Elm State University Dining ready 1 day late, late penalty applies), and reply to Marlow within three business days or Option B applies by default.
Decide whether to warn the affected customer (Tall Pines under Option A, Elm State University Dining under Option B) about the partial late shipment.
supplier_questions: Which shipping option (A or B) does Copperline want for PO-5520? Reply requested within three business days; Marlow will go with Option B if they don't hear back.
